caption: The drawing depicts a single clear drinking glass rendered in shades of gray, black, and white pencil or ink on a light beige background. The glass has a slightly flared, cylindrical shape with a rounded rim at the top. The upper third of the glass is relatively smooth and lightly shaded, while the middle section features a prominent diamond-patterned texture. Below this patterned band, another band with diagonal lines wraps around the glass. The lowest section of the glass displays vertical grooves that run from the base upward to the band above. The shading is used to create a sense of transparency and depth in the glass. The drawing is centered on the page with ample blank space on all sides, and the name “Michael Trekru” is handwritten in small uppercase letters near the bottom right. A thin, horizontal line with small tick marks appears in the bottom left corner, possibly serving as a scale reference.
title: Flip Glass
